answers.question: The new enquire buttons sit on cards with a thick brass stripe down the left edge. Swap it for a thin steel outline all round?
On a phone, the line after each enquire button starts with a stray comma (", and tell us which puppy…"). Hide that comma on screen?
On a phone, the statement-label notes and the puppy cards' "comes home with" and delivery lines are 13px, the smallest text on the page. Make them 14px on phones?
On a phone, the site header is two rows and 121px tall on every screen. Make it one 73px row, with the menu as an icon?
answers.text: and let the "Available puppies"  be in the middle/center. that is logo left, "Available puppies"  and menu icon right on phone.

answers.question: On a desktop, the six puppy cards sit three across and are cramped (the colour and delivery lines wrap awkwardly). Show them two across, as on a tablet?
